text:
mira: quick Q — when we expose dry-run config previews in the Console, should we show the computed 'effective routing' (cohort weights + fallbacks) or keep it as the raw override JSON? ops keeps asking whether what they see is what will actually route.
charles: +1 show computed. ops always misreads raw overrides. we should show both: raw override (collapsed) + computed preview. :mag_right:
jess: agree, but we need to surface sampling confidence — previewing computed weights without sample size is misleading. show `sample_size_estimate` and `sampling_window` next to the heatmap.
henry: careful — our telemetry aggregation can lag 10-15m in peak. if we show realtime-looking routing heatmap + stale metrics, ops will flip flags. we need an explicit staleness badge and an anchor to the telemetry timestamp. :warning:
sophia: API proposal: add a query param to GET /v1/configs/:id?preview=true that returns { "effective_config": {...}, "sampling_meta": {"estimated_samples": 12000, "window_secs": 900, "as_of": "2026-03-23T10:12:00Z" } } so Console can display computed routing + provenance. we can default preview to respect target environment (staging/production).
ux-anna: UI note: show a small inline legend — "computed from: base config + override X + routing policy Y" and a toggle to reveal raw JSON. also show a little timeline scrub for sampling window. keeps the card compact.
mira: love that. ops asked for an "explain" link that shows which rule contributed to each cohort weight — can API return a small trace? e.g. ["rule: tenant-hash -> group A +10%", "fallback: region->latency-pool"]
charles: we can return a short lineage array (strings) but avoid returning the full evaluator trace (too noisy). maybe cap to 5 lines.
jess: telemetry budget question — if every preview triggers a heavy backend computation we could explode cost. suggest computing previews async and caching for 30s; Console requests show cached copy with freshness. previews for prod should be rate-limited per user org.
henry: implement cheap fast path: compute effective routing deterministically from config diffs (no heavy sampling) for preview. sampling_meta is only an estimate from recent telemetry. only run the expensive simulation when user clicks "simulate with traffic".
sophia: agree. add header X-Preview-Cache: hit/miss and X-Preview-As-Of to API responses. Console can surface that.
ops-bot: NOTICE: preflight check for config apply 6149877777 — found 2 tenants that would move >30% of traffic to new pool. Runbook: /runbooks/config-large-shift.
mira: that's helpful. can we add a soft-block on applies >25% w/o canary? at least show a strong warning and require confirmation.
ux-anna: UI microflow: if block triggers, show modal with highlighted affected tenants, simple heatmap, and 2-step confirm + checkbox "I acknowledge risk" — record audit entry.
charles: need API support for an "apply_intent" resource that stores requested apply + metadata (user, reason, preview snapshot) — so ops and audit can reference it later.
jess: also record telemetry snapshot id used for the sampling estimate to make evauation reproducible.
henry: one more: expose a metric for "preview_to_apply_ratio" so product can see how many previews lead to actual applies — helps justify compute cost.
sophia: timeline: I'll open a tiny API PR for preview params + headers. charles, can you sketch the apply_intent schema? i can wire Console afterwards.
charles: will do. sketch in thread in a bit.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: platform-api preview-service v2 -> canary (sha: a1b2c3) by @sophia :package:
mira: thanks — looping in @henry for cache TTL + ops knobs.
henry: on it. planning: cache 30s, simulate button triggers async job (queueable), previews rate limit 10/min/org.
mira: perfect. I'll update the runbook with the new modal wording and link to apply_intent. thanks everyone. :rocket:
